findings.current: “You didn’t know? No wonder he didn’t tell you through his Disciple.”
findings.defect: The translation makes an unspecified Disciple the intermediary who should have delivered the message to Taekyung. Taekyung himself is Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple; Zhuge Feng means he expected Jeok to pass the message to them through Taekyung.
findings.rationale: 제자를 통해서 describes Jeok communicating through his Disciple, not communicating to Taekyung through another Disciple.
findings.replacement: “You didn’t know? That explains why he didn’t pass the message along through his Disciple.”

findings.defect: The present-tense question asks an obviously awake person whether he is asleep. Hyuk Mujin is reacting to Taekyung’s appearance and asking whether he failed to sleep.
findings.rationale: 안 주무셨 uses the past/perfect sense here: Hyuk Mujin begins asking whether Taekyung did not sleep.

findings.current: Some vicious assassin bastard had installed more than a dozen hidden weapons inside the tent
findings.defect: “More than a dozen” raises the quantity beyond twelve, while 십여 개 means roughly ten or a dozen or so.
findings.rationale: 십여 개 denotes approximately ten, not specifically more than twelve.
findings.replacement: Some vicious assassin bastard had installed a dozen or so hidden weapons inside the tent
findings.source: 웬 악독한 살수 새끼가 막사 내부에 십여 개의 암기를 설치했고

findings.current: *Medical apprentice, my ass. Is he the Divine Physician or a Poison Physician?*
findings.defect: The draft turns the second punchline into an either-or question. The source rejects “Divine Physician” and asserts that Mungyeong is a “Poison Physician.”
findings.rationale: 저게 신의냐 is a rhetorical rejection, and 독의지 supplies the corrective assertion.
findings.replacement: *Medical apprentice, my ass. That’s no Divine Physician. He’s a Poison Physician.*
findings.source: ‘의생 같은 소리하고 있네. 저게 신의냐, 독의지.’

findings.current: “Slaughter Saint—no, Mungyeong gave it to me.
findings.defect: The draft completes the title that Cheongpung cuts off after its first syllable, losing the audible self-correction.
findings.rationale: 살, 아니 preserves an interrupted start rather than stating the full title 살성.

summary: One subject-object error changes how Jeok Cheongang’s message was expected to be delivered. Four localized issues alter tense, quantity, an interrupted title, or a punchline.
